source_boundary: Read only public_questions.json groups 8–14, their actual question PNGs, and own frozen first-answer file; never opened curves.py, author answers, groups.json, questions.json or solution PNGs.
method: First visually opened all 21 question PNGs and froze answers before any automated model. Then separately decoded visible ring sectors, petals, Venn regions, beads, gap/corner positions, filled droplet silhouettes, and curve orientation/dash density from PNG pixels, and wrote fresh operations from public rule text. Compared computed result against all four decoded options.
